limitations: This is a read-only evidence inventory by /root/publish_evidence_inventory, not authoring, new reader simulation, independent content re-review, page pass, publication acceptance or reading-time estimation.

Original audit has source judgments for 325 canonical pages, 1174 sequential main checkpoints, 6 groups per role; grouped prerequisite routes are not a single reader reading the entire book in sequence. Historical reviewer identities/independence are report and trace claims; this inventory cannot produce past orchestration API receipts.

Current 288 exact original source identities have candidate reuse; 37 changed canonical pages have bounded repair evidence, with 9 later changed canonical pages represented in callback02. The two extras are not canonical.
Original architecture main lacks a contemporaneous helper seal. A preserved retrospective attestation cites the pre-supplement root message/hash; it cannot manufacture the absent helper receipt.
Original modalities prewritten image descriptions must remain visible as exposure limitations; preserved actual-view corrections are subsequent evidence.
Freeze01 premature full-page context exposure affects 5.4, 10.11,19.12; separately preserved fresh replacement reader records exist. Callback02 never becomes a new blind reading by relabeling.

Callback02 technical and continuity roles are each one actual original extensions reviewer extended to ten pages, not six group-specific role callbacks. All reader callbacks have actual page-specific membership. The original C technical/continuity work was concurrent; any post-technical rereading must be a separate actual append-only record, never a relabeling of prior C chronology.
Some coordinator callback references are group-wide and include reports that did not review the particular page; only actual report page_id/source_sha256 membership may support that page.
Old source hash matches permit source-evidence reuse, but do not by themselves prove unaffected prerequisite semantics, current publication UI, runtime-output placement or new comprehension.

Actual visual inspection was sampled and source-preview based. Automated desktop/mobile DOM capture of all pages is not manual visual reading of all pages; original and repair previews omitted executed model outputs.
AI-assisted review is not actual target-student testing. Kernel execution, training, hosted deployment and publication-output verification are outside this inventory.

All closure counts are author/coordinator records with concrete report references, not new independent resolutions invented by this inventory. Old originals and callback disagreement history remain unchanged.
